name: Gurdwara Guru Nanak Punjabi Sabha
description: Gurdwara Guru Nanak Punjabi Sabha Chakala, founded by Late Dr. Shamsher Singh Jolly & Punjabi Sabha Initiatives, was built through the generous offerings and dedicated participation of the Sangat. The current standing structure was completed and has been operational since 1962. A peaceful spiritual home in the heart of Andheri East, we welcome everyone for daily kirtan, path, and katha in our serene darbar hall. Join us for heartfelt langar served with love, especially vibrant on Sundays and Gurpurab celebrations. Our on-site charitable dispensary offers medical care to the community & continuing the tradition of selfless seva. All are invited to experience devotion, unity, and compassion. Waheguru Ji Ka Khalsa, Waheguru Ji Ki Fateh.

featured_reviews.name: Sarthak Choudhary
featured_reviews.review_text:
Gurudwara Shri Nanak Darbar is a place that truly radiates peace, devotion, and a strong sense of community. Located in Borivali, it offers a calm and spiritual escape from the fast-paced life of Mumbai.

The atmosphere inside the Gurudwara is incredibly serene, with soothing kirtans creating a deeply calming experience. Whether you visit regularly or for the first time, there’s a sense of warmth and welcome that makes you feel instantly at ease.

One of the most beautiful aspects is the langar seva, where everyone is served simple yet delicious food with humility and equality. The volunteers are kind and dedicated, ensuring everything is well-organized and that every visitor feels respected.

The premises are clean, well-maintained, and managed efficiently, allowing devotees to focus entirely on prayer and reflection. Overall, Gurudwara Shri Nanak Darbar is not just a place of worship, but a space that offers peace, positivity, and a sense of belonging.

featured_reviews.name: Rushikesh Bhoir
featured_reviews.review_text:
Attending my first Punjabi friend's wedding at a gurdwara was a beautiful experience. The entire atmosphere of the gurdwara, with its serene and welcoming ambiance, felt truly sacred and peaceful. As I entered, I was drawn to the calmness of the place, with the soft hum of prayers and the faint scent of incense filling the air. The sense of devotion was overwhelming yet calming, creating an indescribable sense of tranquility.

The wedding rituals themselves were simple yet deeply meaningful. The couple’s walk around the Guru Granth Sahib, the holy scripture, symbolized their spiritual commitment. I was fascinated by the importance of equality and humility in the Sikh faith; everyone sat together on the floor, heads covered, symbolizing unity and respect. The langar (community meal) served after the ceremony was a highlight, as it embodies the Sikh value of selfless service.

The experience left a lasting impression on me. The gurdwara’s traditions and values, like community, compassion, and devotion, were truly inspiring. It felt like a place of pure spirituality and peace, and it made me appreciate the warmth and inclusivity of Sikh culture even more.

featured_reviews.name: aruna mukerjee
featured_reviews.review_text:
I wouldn't even give one star but since i have to make others aware about the scammers here, i am doing so.

On the pretext of being a religious place, the representative of this Gurudwara functions hand-in-glove with valet parking organisations. On the occasion of Guru Nanak Jayanti, we visited in the evening and promptly handed over our car keys to the valet person. After more than 35 minutes of waiting, a threat to contact the police and a useless Gurudwara representative who did nothing, we were handed over our car without even an apology. Our car when we checked, had been running for 35 minutes and 10 kms with the AC running on 19 degrees. All this while, our old parents waited on the footpath while the valet guy chilled in our car and the Gurudwara representative was utterly useless and paid no attention to us or the urged the valets to do the right thing despite multiple requests.

It is such a shame that such a sacred place is associated with individuals who are focussed on scamming people. Next time, no matter what, don't hand over your car keys to any valet service here or any person from the Gurudwara.

I would also advice people to think twice before they even make any donations to this place, since this may just be the tip of the iceberg.

featured_reviews.review_text:
I had the privilege of visiting Sri Guru Nanak Darbar in Mira Road East on the occasion of Baisakhi, and it was truly a soul-stirring experience. The entire gurdwara was beautifully decorated, creating a warm and festive atmosphere that instantly lifted my spirits.

From the moment I stepped in, there was a sense of peace and spiritual calm. The kirtan was deeply moving, and the energy of the sangat coming together in celebration of such a significant day in Sikh history was heartening. The Baisakhi celebrations were well-organized, with traditional hymns, prayers, and a sense of togetherness that reminded me of the true essence of community and seva.

The langar was served with immense love and humility – simple yet wholesome, just as it should be. I could see volunteers of all ages working selflessly, which added to the sense of unity and devotion.

Overall, the visit to Sri Guru Nanak Darbar on Baisakhi left a lasting impression on me. It’s a place where faith, peace, and community come together beautifully. I highly recommend visiting, especially during such auspicious occasions.

featured_reviews.name: pappu kumar yadav
featured_reviews.review_text: I've been coming to this Gurdwara for the past three years. All the attendants are fine, and the existing cleaning staff are also very good. However, some of the new cleaning staff, two women, are absolutely vile and low-grade. They start quarreling and abusing anyone, which is wrong. People come here out of necessity for treatment. The management is requested to remove these two new staff members as soon as possible. Thank you.

featured_reviews.name: Biswajit Bhowmick
featured_reviews.review_text:
The place is supportive for cancer patients, offering convenient access to TATA Hospital by both train and car. You'll receive complimentary meals, including Two meals a day and tea ( Breakfast provided on Saturday and Sunday , 9am ) .

The room is comfortable, featuring an attached bathroom, two beds, a table, a chair, an almirah, a wash basin, and a ceiling fan.

featured_reviews.name: Raytron Instrument Services
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently had the opportunity to visit the Panth Nagar Gurudwara, and it was a truly peaceful and uplifting experience. The entire premises were very clean and well-maintained, creating a serene and welcoming environment. The spiritual atmosphere inside the Gurudwara gave me a deep sense of calm and inner peace.

It’s not just a place of worship, but also a place to reflect, to connect with yourself, and to
learn valuable lessons about living a meaningful and compassionate life. I’m truly grateful for the experience and would recommend a visit to anyone looking for spiritual comfort and inspiration.

customer_updates.name: Rosy Kohli
customer_updates.text:
I went to a prayer meeting in the afternoon on Thursday ,When you visit the gurudwara sit & listen to kirtan you get connected to waheguru ji , Peace of mind & Soul .
The Gurudwara is near to khar  Station walkable distance .
The entrance is not accessible ♿ there are 2 steps ,but steel rods are there u can hold it .
But sevadar helps to lift wheel chairs there and lift also inside.
There is no parking space.The gurudwara can be easily seen from the road.

featured_reviews.name: Harshal Kadu
featured_reviews.review_text:
Dhan Guru Nanak Dev Ji Maharaj. Every visit to this Gurudwara fills the heart with peace and positivity. The divine atmosphere, soulful Gurbani, and selfless seva create a truly blessed experience. Thank you to all the sevadars who work tirelessly to maintain this sacred place. Waheguru Ji bless everyone. 🙏🏻

The Gurudwara is located at Khar West, Mumbai and is highly rated by visitors for its cleanliness, peaceful environment, and langar seva.

featured_reviews.name: Anil Singh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Very well maintained, neat and well kept Gurudwara. There is not a speck of dust and dirt anywhere and even the carpets were very well kept.
The darbar sahab was very serene and calming. Marble inlay work is there on the boundry wall of the gurudwara.

featured_reviews.name: Sahaj Umang Singh Bhatia
featured_reviews.review_text:
Peaceful, well organised environs with very helpful and supportive Sevadars.

Sangat should use public transport since street parking can congest the road.

featured_reviews.name: Gurpreet Singh
featured_reviews.review_text: Gurudwara is one of the best place to find peace and calm your mind. I always visited in morning and evening for enchanting of Gurbani and Simran.

featured_reviews.name: Rosy Kohli
featured_reviews.review_text:
It's is one of oldest Gurudware of Mumbai,my Anand karaj (Marriage Ceremony) was done, here 25 years ago.There are many changes done by Gurudware committee like putting lift inside the Gurudwara to help senior citizen & it help's handicap people come to Gurudwara & attend daily prayer's .
Ac are put inside & Down hall also.
Every day morning & evening people come to listen prayers.
Ladies on Monday do Prayers & kirtan.
Gurpurb are celebrate many people attend langar is prepared & served in the hall.
The Gurudwara is walking distance from khar station & S.V road bus stop.
One should visit take blessings of Guru Granth Saibh.
Only cover your head ,Wash your hand.
People who drink ,eat tobacco ,smoke is not allowed .
You should keep your Mobile on silent mode.

featured_reviews.name: Kirtan Chavda
featured_reviews.review_text:
I've visited on Monday, 16th June 2025 in evening time, at around 19:50 I reached. When I reached it was prayer time and its almost end of the prayer, lady devotee was singing some prayers beautifully. After prayers there's a prasad (langar) which is so delicious and authentic.

Gurudwara is just 5 mins walking from Khar road railway station platform number 1A (West side). Gurudwara is peaceful and calm. Also cleanliness is top class. Prayer hall and langar (Dinning) hall is soo specious. Shoe house is allocated to keep footwears safely. Although its nearest to the railway station area still Washroom and surrounding was properly clean and hygienic.

Entrance gate is constructed of white marbles and the ambiance was so good. Vibe was good.

PS. No pictures is taken.

featured_reviews.review_text: Attended a pray meeting of someone who i knew, very peaceful.

Spacious and Good air conditioned langar hall

featured_reviews.name: Kavita Ranjan
featured_reviews.review_text: Great shelter for cancer patients and their attendants/relatives. Rooms are well ventilated with options of with or without attached bathrooms.
